notes: Local master is stale (eee0ed4); origin/master already contains PR #17 (tracking). Reviewed the 3 commits after d67267b: e5d68a5 (MCP SSO tokens), 5036325 (empty-intersection refusal, cause logging, SSO principal re-entry), 92bc502 (web run-tool.mjs).
Verified: go test ./internal/proxy (full package, 63s) passes; gofmt/go vet clean; node --test web/scripts/run-tool.test.mjs passes (4/4).

Tests genuinely exercise the change: TestMCPOAuthEmptyScopeIntersectionIsRefusedNotUnscoped hits /mcp/gateway (apiScopeForRequest returns "" there), which pre-fix would have passed an empty-scope principal through; TestMCPOAuthGatewayToolsRunAsTheSSOSubject proves gateway_chat runs only via the context principal (no key exists for the subject) and that the REST door still 401s the same token; TestMCPOAuthRefusalLogsTheCause asserts the slog line by code+cause.

Feature is default-off (mcp.oauth.enabled=false) and additionally gated on AUTH_ENABLED + Keycloak issuer; key auth path is byte-for-byte unchanged when off. Context principal (mcpPrincipalKey) can only be set by handleGatewayMCP after authenticateMCP succeeded — no external request can inject it. Reversible by revert; new settings rows are inert when the code is gone.

internal/proxy/mcp_oauth.go:343 — the web sign-in client id (SSO_KEYCLOAK_CLIENT_ID) is always an accepted aud/azp, so any access token Keycloak mints for the console client opens /mcp. Documented and intentional, but an operator who wants MCP restricted to a dedicated client cannot switch this off.

internal/proxy/mcp_oauth.go:433 — a Keycloak discovery/JWKS outage is returned as a 401 issuer_unavailable refusal (authDenied) rather than authUnavailable/503; clients will treat a transient IdP outage as a bad credential. Design choice, not a defect.

internal/proxy/mcp_oauth.go:181 — when both mcp.oauth.resource and the Keycloak redirect URI are empty the resource identifier falls back to the request Host, which is caller-influenced; only matters if Keycloak were also configured to mint tokens for that aud. Docs already call it a last resort.

internal/proxy/mcp_oauth.go:490 — WWW-Authenticate error_description carries Korean text; Go sends it, but non-ASCII header values are outside RFC 9110's safe set and some proxies/clients may mangle it.
internal/proxy/mcp_oauth_test.go:645 — TestMCPOAuthRefusalLogsTheCause swaps slog.Default; safe today because the package's tests are not t.Parallel, but would race if that changes.

web/package.json build script: with `pnpm run build --silent` only the trailing `vite build` segment receives the flag (pnpm appends to the end of the script line), which is what run-tool strips — tsc segment never sees it. Consistent with the commit's description.
